articles.title: MeT Forecasts Fresh Rain, Snowfall in Jammu Kashmir

articles.title: Indian voters fight to restore names after mass deletions from electoral rolls
articles.summary: Tailor Kamta Prasad and millions of others in India discovered their names were removed from electoral rolls during a voter revision process in New Delhi. The widespread deletions have sparked mass protests against Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the Election Commission. Affected citizens must navigate complex bureaucratic procedures to prove their identities and restore their voting rights.

articles.title: Delhi Police transfers trespassing case against two CJP leaders to Crime Branch
articles.summary: Delhi Police transferred the Jantar Mantar trespassing case involving Cockroach Janata Party leaders Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das to the Crime Branch on Monday. A special executive magistrate extended their judicial custody by two days following their arrest last week for unauthorized entry and raising slogans. Leaders criticized the detention as misuse of power.

articles.title: Punjab Police Official Shoots Wife, 2 Sons Over Domestic Dispute, Later Kills Self
articles.summary: A Punjab Police official on Tuesday allegedly shot his wife and two sons before killing himself in Punjab’s Mansa district. According to preliminary information, the incident appears to be linked to a domestic dispute. Police told CNN-News18 that Gurwinder Singh, a gunman assigned to the Deputy Commissioner of Mansa, opened fire on Tuesday morning, allegedly killing himself.

articles.title: Young Indians Face Trust Deficit in Key State Institutions
articles.summary: Recent controversies involving the Election Commission of India and the National Testing Agency highlight a growing trust crisis among young citizens. Heavy police responses to youth protests fail to restore confidence in democratic systems. Experts suggest young Indians should channel their energy into constructive grassroots programs, drawing inspiration from Mahatma Gandhi and Jayaprakash Narayan to rebuild society alongside political resistance.
articles.title_hi: युवा भारतीयों को प्रमुख राज्य संस्थानों में भरोसे की कमी का सामना करना पड़ता है

articles.title_hinglish: yuva bharatiyon ko pramukha rajya sansthanon men bharose ki kami ka samana karana padata hai
articles.summary_hinglish: bharata ke chunava aayoga aura rashtriya parikshana ejensi se judaे haliya vivada yuva nagarikon ke bicha badhate vishvasa sankata ko ujagara karate hain। yuvaon ke virodha pradarshanon para pulisa ki bhari pratikriya lokatantrika pranaliyon men vishvasa bahala karane men viphala rahi। visheshajnyon ka sujhava hai ki yuva bharatiyon ko rajanitika pratirodha ke satha-satha samaja ke punarnirmana ke lie mahatma gandhi aura jayaprakasha narayana se prerana lete hue apani oorja rachanatmaka jamini stara ke karyakramon men lagani chahie।

articles.title_hinglish: kya rilayansa jiyo vaishvika niveshakon ke samane khuda ko eka praudyogiki diggaja ke rupa men pesha kara sakata hai?
articles.summary_hinglish: mukesha anbani ki rilayansa jiyo bharatiya sheyara bajara ke itihasa men sabase badaे pravesha dvaron men se eka banane ki taiyari kara rahi hai। lagabhaga ₹30,000 karoda ki prastavita aaranbhika sarvajanika peshakasha aura sanbhavita mulyankana ₹10 taka pahunchane ke satha। 3 lakha karoda rupaye ke sath, Jio pletaphaॉrma khuda ko bharata ke sabase badaे mobaila telikoma ऑparetara se kahin adhika mahatvakankshi ke rupa men sthapita kara raha hai।

articles.title: Gurgaon overshot annual PM10 limit in April, 22 Haryana cities cross benchmark
articles.summary: It took just 101 days this year for Gurgaon to accumulate enough PM10 pollution to breach India’s annual air quality standard, with the city crossing the benchmark on April 11 — more than a month earlier than in 2025, when it did so on May 16, according to data shared by Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA).

articles.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi faces mounting political and economic pressure across India
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi faces growing political fatigue, rising youth unemployment, and public protests across Indian urban centers. Opposition parties are demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over electoral concerns. Meanwhile, economic distress, declining consumer confidence, and strained foreign relations have intensified pressure on the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party government, exposing widespread public discontent and institutional friction.
articles.title_hi: प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी पूरे भारत में बढ़ते राजनीतिक और आर्थिक दबाव का सामना कर रहे हैं

articles.title: Manipur violence kills 4; locals place bodies outside CM's house
articles.summary: In the first incident, violence erupted during a musical event in a locality inhabited by Meiteis and Pangal Muslims. A senior police official said that there were stone-pelting and gunfire. Several people were injured. A 24-year-old man later succumbed to bullet injuries. Officials said that villagers marched towards the CM's high-security bungalow in Imphal, carrying the bodies of the victims.

articles.summary_hi: पहली घटना में, मेइतीस और पंगाल मुसलमानों के निवास वाले इलाके में एक संगीत कार्यक्रम के दौरान हिंसा भड़क उठी। एक वरिष्ठ पुलिस अधिकारी ने बताया कि पथराव और गोलीबारी हुई. कई लोग घायल हो गये. गोली लगने से घायल 24 वर्षीय एक व्यक्ति की बाद में मौत हो गई। अधिकारियों ने कहा कि ग्रामीणों ने पीड़ितों के शव लेकर इंफाल में सीएम के उच्च सुरक्षा वाले बंगले की ओर मार्च किया।

articles.title: BJP may drop 30-40% of Uttar Pradesh MLAs ahead of 2027 polls
articles.summary: In the 2022 assembly polls, retained BJP candidates had an 85% strike rate, compared with 77% for those brought in to replace the sitting MLAs. The 2024 Lok Sabha results told a different story: New candidates who replaced sitting MPs won 11 of 16 seats while only 20 of the 46 incumbents won.

articles.title: Delhi police crime branch takes over trespass case of party leaders
articles.summary: The investigation into Cockroach Janata Party leaders Ashutosh Ranka and Sourav Das has been transferred to the Delhi Police Crime Branch. A Delhi court extended their judicial custody until October 21 after they allegedly violated peace bonds and trespassed into Jantar Mantar without authorization during a protest. The court rejected their fresh sureties due to document discrepancies.

articles.summary: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) and the Government of Japan have signed financing agreements with AM Green Ammonia (India) to help build one of the world’s largest plants to make ammonia using renewable energy in India, marking the first investment under the Action for Creating Energy Security for Long-term Resilience (ACCEL).

articles.summary_hi: एशियाई विकास बैंक (एडीबी) और जापान सरकार ने भारत में नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा का उपयोग करके अमोनिया बनाने के लिए दुनिया के सबसे बड़े संयंत्रों में से एक के निर्माण में मदद करने के लिए एएम ग्रीन अमोनिया (भारत) के साथ वित्तपोषण समझौते पर हस्ताक्षर किए हैं, जो दीर्घकालिक लचीलेपन के लिए ऊर्जा सुरक्षा बनाने की कार्रवाई (एसीसीईएल) के तहत पहला निवेश है।
articles.title_hinglish: edibi aura japana ne bharata men harita amoniya sanyantra ke lie vittaposhana samajhaute para hastakshara kie
articles.summary_hinglish: eshiyaee vikasa bainka (edibi) aura japana sarakara ne bharata men navikaraniya oorja ka upayoga karake amoniya banane ke lie duniya ke sabase badaे sanyantron men se eka ke nirmana men madada karane ke lie eema grina amoniya (bharata) ke satha vittaposhana samajhaute para hastakshara kie hain, jo dirghakalika lachilepana ke lie oorja suraksha banane ki karravaee (esisieeela) ke tahata pahala nivesha hai।

articles.title: Rev Beilieü Shüya: The Pioneer of Christian Revival Church in Arunachal Pradesh
articles.summary: 1928 to 18. 9. 2026), remembered as the first CRC woman to be ordained, passed away at the age of 98 in Kohima, leaving behind a remarkable legacy of Christian faith, missionary commitment, education, and service. Her life was a testimony to perseverance, spiritual conviction, and obedience to the call of GOD, extending her influence beyond Nagaland into Arunachal Pradesh.
articles.title_hi: रेव बेइलिउ शुया: अरुणाचल प्रदेश में ईसाई पुनरुद्धार चर्च के अग्रणी
articles.summary_hi: 1928 से 18. 9. 2026), जिन्हें पहली सीआरसी महिला के रूप में याद किया जाता है, का कोहिमा में 98 वर्ष की आयु में निधन हो गया, जो अपने पीछे ईसाई धर्म, मिशनरी प्रतिबद्धता, शिक्षा और सेवा की एक उल्लेखनीय विरासत छोड़ गईं। उनका जीवन दृढ़ता, आध्यात्मिक दृढ़ विश्वास और भगवान के आह्वान के प्रति आज्ञाकारिता का प्रमाण था, जिसने उनके प्रभाव को नागालैंड से परे अरुणाचल प्रदेश तक बढ़ाया।
articles.title_hinglish: reva beiliu shuy: arunachala pradesha men eesaee punaruddhara charcha ke agrani
articles.summary_hinglish: 1928 se 18. 9. 2026), jinhen pahali siaarasi mahila ke rupa men yada kiya jata hai, ka kohima men 98 varsha ki aayu men nidhana ho gay, jo apane pichhe eesaee dharm, mishanari pratibaddhat, shiksha aura seva ki eka ullekhaniya virasata chhoda gaeen। unaka jivana dridhat, aadhyatmika dridha vishvasa aura bhagavana ke aahvana ke prati aajnyakarita ka pramana th, jisane unake prabhava ko nagalainda se pare arunachala pradesha taka badhaाya।
